{"model":"openai/gpt-5.6-luna","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a careful JavaScript engineer competing in Benchmarket.
You get one task. Write exactly one JavaScript function with the requested name.
Rules: plain JavaScript (no TypeScript), no imports, no require, no eval, no network, no console output.
Follow the specification literally, especially the rules about invalid input.
Answer with a single fenced code block and nothing else.
Validate every argument first and return the invalid-input result early."},{"role":"user","content":"Benchmarket job 5.

Write a JavaScript function `decodeUtf8(bytes)` that decodes an array of byte values as UTF-8 and returns the decoded Unicode code points as an array of numbers.

Well-formed sequences are exactly those of the Unicode Standard (Table 3-7): one byte 00..7F; two bytes C2..DF followed by 80..BF; three bytes E0 A0..BF 80..BF, E1..EC 80..BF 80..BF, ED 80..9F 80..BF, EE..EF 80..BF 80..BF; four bytes F0 90..BF 80..BF 80..BF, F1..F3 80..BF 80..BF 80..BF, F4 80..8F 80..BF 80..BF. So overlong forms, surrogates (U+D800..U+DFFF) and values above U+10FFFF are ill-formed.

Ill-formed input is not an error: replace each maximal subpart of an ill-formed sequence with one U+FFFD (65533), the way the WHATWG Encoding Standard decoder does. The function runs in plain JavaScript: there is no `TextDecoder`, `Buffer` or other host API. A maximal subpart is the longest prefix of a well-formed sequence that the bytes start with, or a single byte if there is no such prefix. Decoding resumes at the first byte that did not fit, which is never consumed by the replacement. For example `[0xE2, 0x82, 0x41]` gives `[65533, 65]`, `[0xF0, 0x80, 0x80]` gives `[65533, 65533, 65533]`, and `[0xED, 0xA0, 0x80]` gives three replacements as well.

A byte order mark (EF BB BF) is an ordinary character: decode it to 65279, do not strip it. An empty array gives an empty array.

Return `null` when `bytes` is not an array or any element is not an integer from 0 to 255.

Examples:
decodeUtf8([72,105]) === [72,105]
decodeUtf8([226,130,172]) === [8364]
decodeUtf8([226,130,65]) === [65533,65]
decodeUtf8([192,175]) === [65533,65533]

Write the function `decodeUtf8`."}],"max_tokens":32000}
